name: zj-cyber-workbench
description: Multi-agent cyber operations workbench for authorized security testing and infrastructure operations.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @zj-security/web build && pnpm --filter @zj-security/desktop build && pnpm --filter @zj-security/skillhub-web build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @zj-security/web typecheck && pnpm --filter @zj-security/desktop typecheck && pnpm --filter @zj-security/skillhub-web typecheck
scripts.test: uv run python -m unittest discover -s tests -p "test_*.py" && pnpm typecheck
scripts.test:d-runtime: uv run python -m unittest tests.integration.test_d_mock_runtime tests.unit.test_d_agent_quality_assets
